message.teleport.blocked: Teleporting is disabled on this server
options.teleport.title: teleport Settings
options.teleport.click_tp.tooltip: Right-clicking a block teleports you to it on your client. Sneak to use blocks and items normally. The toggle key switches the same setting. It has no effect on servers the multiplayer mode rules out.
options.teleport.click_tp_reach.tooltip: How far away, in blocks, Click TP finds the block you look at (%s to %s).
options.teleport.click_tp_preview.toolti: Shows a translucent copy of you where Click TP would put you.
options.teleport.singleplayer_default.to: The Click TP state restored in singleplayer worlds when a reset applies.
options.teleport.multiplayer_default.too: The Click TP state restored on servers the multiplayer mode allows when a reset applies.
options.teleport.reset_on_world_exit.too: Every world starts with Click TP in its default state instead of keeping the last state.
options.teleport.reset_on_game_exit.tool: After restarting the game, the first world where the mod is allowed starts with Click TP in its default state.
options.teleport.multiplayer_mode.toolti:
%s

Client teleports may be set back by the server, and servers with anti-cheat may kick or ban you for them. This mod does not try to bypass any anti-cheat.
options.teleport.multiplayer_mode.whitel: Teleports only on servers in the server list.
options.teleport.multiplayer_mode.blackl: Teleports on all servers except those in the server list.
options.teleport.edit_servers.tooltip: Edit the addresses used by the whitelist and blacklist modes.
options.teleport.servers.title: Server List
teleport.command.get.spectator: %s is not loaded on your client. As a spectator, you can reach it with the spectator teleport.
teleport.command.spectator: Asked the server to teleport you to %s (spectator teleport)
teleport.command.selector_unsupported: This selector cannot be evaluated on the client
teleport.command.not_loaded: %s is not loaded on your client, and nothing else tells where it is
teleport.command.not_loaded.chunk: %s is not loaded on your client. The locator bar only shows that it is in chunk %s, %s (X %s to %s, Z %s to %s)
teleport.command.not_loaded.direction: %s is not loaded on your client. The locator bar only shows its direction: yaw %s (%s)
teleport.command.other_dimension: That location is in %s. Client teleports cannot change dimension
teleport.command.no_back: No previous position in this dimension
teleport.command.no_home: No home is set. Use /tp @c sethome
teleport.command.no_temp: No temp location is set. Use /tp @c settemp
teleport.command.no_spawn: Your respawn point is not known yet
teleport.command.no_worldspawn: The world spawn is not known
teleport.command.not_in_world: You are not in a world
teleport.menu.title: Client teleport destinations:
teleport.menu.all_entities.hint: List every entity you can teleport to
teleport.menu.set.home.hint: Save your current position as home
teleport.menu.set.temp.hint: Save your current position as temp
modmenu.descriptionTranslation.teleport: Teleports you on your client without asking the server: /tp @c, Click TP, back, home and more.
